title: Waiting for the Rainbow Behind the Dark Clouds
description: In “Waiting for the Rainbow Behind the Dark Clouds,” by Halima Nazir, an EmpowerHer student, the writer tells a symbolic story of an Afghan girl who dares to seek knowledge despite fear and restriction. Through Laila’s journey, the piece shows how education becomes an act of hope and resistance, affirming that Afghan girls’ dreams endure even under injustice.
from: National Society of High School Scholars (NSHSS)
